skill.name: fileOperationSkill
skill.skillDescription: Read, write and edit files on the local filesystem. Operations: read (pass offset/limit to read a RANGE of a large file, output has line numbers; the 'N| ' prefix is display-only - do not copy it into old_string), write, edit (exact old_string->new_string replace; add context if not unique; set replace_all; prefer edit over write for existing files - never rewrite a whole file for a small change), list, exists, delete, search (regex content search, optional glob filter, default skips .git/node_modules/target dirs), glob (find files by pattern like **/*.py). Set backup=true on write/edit to keep a <file>.bak. After changing code, run it to verify.

skill.name: codeExecutionSkill
skill.skillDescription: Execute inline code snippets in Python or JavaScript.

skill.name: scriptExecutionSkill
skill.skillDescription: Execute an existing script file (.py, .sh, .js etc.) and return its output.
